description: Reverse-ETL sink: mirror an upstream DataFrame into a HubSpot CRM object type via the native batch upsert endpoint. `POST /crm/v3/objects/{objectType}/batch/upsert` atomically creates or updates records based on matching a unique key_property. Chunks at 100 records per HTTP call.

inputs.description: pandas DataFrame from an upstream asset. Each row → one HubSpot CRM record (upserted via key_property).

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata (rows_upserted / rows_errored / batch_count). No downstream data — write side effect lands in HubSpot.

object_type.label: Object Type
object_type.description: contacts / companies / deals / tickets / line_items / products / quotes / or custom (like p123456_custom_thing).

key_property.label: Key Property
key_property.description: HubSpot property used to match rows (typically 'email' for contacts, 'domain' for companies).

batch_size.label: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Records per HubSpot API call. Capped at 100 (HubSpot's limit).

max_rows.label: Max Rows
max_rows.description: Safety cap on total rows per run.

name: HubSpot Object Upsert
